reaction.barNote: * Result of running gcsim (cycle {{lap}}). After editing, positions may be off until you run it again (click to seek to the start)

lunarcharged.label: 🌙 Lunar-Charged cloud
lunarcharged.help: Triggering Lunar-Charged creates a cloud; while it exists, Lunar-Charged DMG hits enemies about every 2 s. Each reaction extends it to 5.5 s

lunarcrystallize.label: 🌙 Lunar-Crystallize (objects)
lunarcrystallize.help: Triggering Lunar-Crystallize creates up to 3 moon crystal objects (9 s). Number = objects at that time

verdantdew.label: 🌿 Verdant Dew (held)
verdantdew.help: Triggering Lunar-Bloom adds 1 Verdant Dew about every 2.4 s for about 2.5 s (max 3; leftover progress carries over to the next Lunar-Bloom). Consumed by Lauma's Skill (up to 3) and Columbina's Charged Attack (1). Number = held at that time

moonridgedew.label: 🌙 Moonridge Dew (held)
moonridgedew.help: Columbina's Passive Talent 2: gains 1 with each Lunar reaction (Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, Lunar-Crystallize), max 3. Each Charged Attack consumes 1 (Verdant Dew first). Number = held at that time

stellarconduct.label: ⭐ Stellar Conduct field
stellarconduct.help: Triggering Stellar Conduct creates a field (6 s, extended by each reaction). Number = active stacks, updated every 4 s (max 12; Cryo/Electro DMG +)

stellarswirl.label: ⭐ Stellar Swirl vortex (stacks)
stellarswirl.help: Triggering Stellar Swirl creates a vortex; each trigger adds 1 stack (max 6). It bursts after about 3 s or at 6 stacks. Number = stacks at that time

stellarswirl_airborne.label: ⭐ After Stellar Swirl burst
stellarswirl_airborne.help: State for 5 s after the Stellar Swirl vortex bursts
